title: A business-card designer agent for Indi: what does it own?
detail: Vicky relayed (f6e35e5, 10:05 UTC) that Dinis asked Indi to start a designer agent for the business cards, with a few options to choose from. Not yet heard from Dinis or Indi directly. Vicky's card content waits for it in people/vicky/business-card.json; designer@web-summit.dinis holds the cards until then (WS-48, WS-113).
recommend: Dinis says in his own words what the agent owns, then Indi starts it today: the ask reached Indi's conductor second-hand
options: Indi starts designer@web-summit.indi today; it owns the cards from now
the cards stay with designer@web-summit.dinis; Indi's agent drafts options only
not now: Indi starts it on Thursday in person
